I have implemented Task 16 (Keyboard Navigation for Full-Size Image Viewer) and committed the changes.

**Summary:**
-   Modified `static/js/app.js` to add state tracking for the current image index and a `navigatePreview` function.
-   Added event listeners for `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` (Next/Prev) and `Cmd/Ctrl` + Arrows (First/Last).
-   Marked Task 16 as complete in `tasks.json`.
-   Committed changes to git.

The image viewer now supports full keyboard navigation.
